messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: HIGH_LATENCY_SLO_BURN (eu-west). p99 = 1.9s (>1.5s), p95 = 0.8s (>0.5s). page: oncall-primary. link: https://observability/redwood/alerts/1709054321 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC-2026-345 created and page fired to @Jamal (on-call). Escalation policy: 10m -> secondary.
Jamal: Acked. I'm jumping on it. Can someone post quick signal links?
metrics-bot: Top metrics snapshot: 
- ingress qps eu-west: 4500
- inference p50/p95/p99: 120ms / 820ms / 1.9s
- sidecar CPU: 72%
- kvcache hitrate: 61% (down from 92% 30m ago)
Alex: seeing correlated autoscaler activity in eu-west. Multiple scale-down/scale-up cycles in the last 6m. Suspect cold-tokenizer spikes + KV cache evictions.
Priya: hunch: autoscaler min replicas too low for the recent burst pattern. Also seeing a noisy tenant causing high seq len. Any hotkeys?
Jamal: Hotkeys: tenant-42 and tenant-otel show elevated tokens. But overall tail traffic is up, not just single hotkey.
Alex: stack traces show tokenization latency bump. Pushing warm-pool size might help. I'm going to bump min replicas and temporarily pin model variant to a smaller context window to reduce latency.
Jamal: Ok do it. Also let's route non-EU traffic to us-east for now to relieve eu-west. We have capacity there.
Alex: running: ```kubectl scale deployment inference-eu --replicas=12 --namespace=redwood-infer```
Alex: kubectl output: scaled deployment "inference-eu" to 12
Alex: increasing warm pool: PUT /admin/warmpool?region=eu-west&size=8 -> 202 Accepted
Alex: pinning model variant: set route /generate -> model "redwood-small-v1" for eu-west (temporary)
pagerduty: Note: If INC-2026-345 is not acknowledged by secondary in 10m will escalate.
Jamal: routing change applied: traffic-shift 30% -> us-east via router service. command: `curl -X POST https://router.internal/shift -d '{"eu-west": -0.3, "us-east": 0.3}'` -> 200 OK.
metrics-bot: after mitigation (2m): p99 -> 1.2s, p95 -> 610ms, kvcache hitrate -> 70%
Priya: improvement trending. Good. We should still track: if p99 doesn't drop under 1.0s in next 10m, escalate to infra for scaling host pools.
Jamal: Customer impact: we have 27 support tickets flagged from EU tenants about slow responses; no hard errors yet. Notifying CS shortly.
Alex: quick debug output from tokenizer sidecar: ```ERROR token-cache eviction pressure: evict_rate=0.34 threshold=0.25```
Alex: bumping cache size on eu-west tokenizers: `/ops/tokenizer/cache?size=1.5GB` -> 200 OK
Priya: good call. Also I'm going to increase autoscaler cool-down to 90s to avoid oscillation. Patch applied: prow job #782 -> merged.
Jamal: PD note: acknowledged by secondary (Priya). Escalation timer stopped.
Sasha: Adding myself to thread, taking handoff in 25m. Can you leave a short runbook?
Jamal: Runbook: 1) monitor p99 & kvcache hitrate; 2) if p99 > 1.5s for 5m, scale inference-eu to 16 replicas and shift 50% traffic to us-east; 3) if kvcache hitrate < 60%, increase tokenizer cache by 50% and restart tokenizer daemonset; 4) open incident ticket INC-2026-345 and update customers via CS only after triage.
Alex: Logging the mitigation steps in incident: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-345/notes. Also added temp revert plan to unpin model after traffic normalizes.
metrics-bot: 10m check-in: p99=980ms, p95=420ms, kvcache=78%, ingress qps eu-west = 3200
Priya: Looks stable. Moving to monitoring. Jamal please handoff to Sasha when you rotate.
Jamal: Handoff done -> I'm out in 20m. Sasha, you're the active owner. If anything flares, wake me. :thumbsup:
Sasha: Got it. I'll keep watch and will call for infra if p99 climbs back above 1.2s. Creating follow-up postmortem stub now.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-345 assigned to Sasha (on-call). Status: mitigated -> monitoring.
pagerduty: Closing note: incident will remain open until postmortem.
Jamal: Thanks all. Closing primary response.
Sasha: I'll file the postmortem and link perf graphs. CC: @Priya @Alex
